## Reserve before billing
A conditional update on a pre-created private Data Table row reserves this sequence. Keep retries on POST disabled. When the POST result is ambiguous the state stays locked. Resolve it against your own Apify run history before continuing. Only a known run may be resumed.

## Read and verify
Check the terminal status, summary, complete dataset and platform event ledger. Any failed check stops the route. A missing summary or expired prior capture also requires review.

## Downstream routing
The result contains a decision and verified Apify references. Attach customer-owned approval, review or ticketing here. Keep DEMO_ONLY and every HOLD or empty-source decision away from production approvals. Key downstream writes by runId for idempotence.
